messages:
ACME Inc (Customer): Hi, our March invoice (INV-98765) is ~3x higher than the dashboard estimate. We compared our client-side SDK's token estimator to the invoice and to the /responses payload — both differ. Can someone help?
Alex R. (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste a minimal repro (curl or SDK) and the invoice line items?
ACME Inc (Customer): attaching trimmed repro below. The SDK locally reports 1,320 tokens, API response shows 1,330, invoice charged 4,010 tokens. No tool calls from our app.
ACME Inc (Customer): ```bash
# curl repro (redacted)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-13b","input":"Summarize:\n- item a\n- item b\n","max_tokens":256}'
```
Sam D. (DevEx): thanks — two quick asks: 1) can you share the raw response body header (if possible) and 2) do you route requests through a proxy/sidecar?
ACME Inc (Customer): we do have an internal side-proxy for logging. We can capture headers.
Alex R. (Support): Billing Bot, can you pull metering events for INV-98765 and show the per-request token breakdown?
Billing Bot: Linking metering dump snippet (truncated): `request_id=req_0ab3, model=rw-13b, prompt_tokens=980, completion_tokens=350, total=1330, meta.injected_tokens=2680`
Mia L. (Eng): aha — `meta.injected_tokens` looks like server-side augmentation. ACME, does your side-proxy add any metadata or pass extra system messages?
ACME Inc (Customer): we only add an `x-customer-log` header and mirror the request body to our logger, nothing else.
Mia L. (Eng): can you reproduce without the side-proxy in the path? In a few prior cases a proxy that rewrites requests inadvertently triggered a runtime transformation that appended a hidden system block for telemetry (our runtime marks those as `meta.injected_tokens`).
ACME Inc (Customer): repro without proxy shows SDK estimate 1,320, API response 1,330, invoice now 1,340 — much closer.
Sam D. (DevEx): good narrowing. So the multiplier came from the proxy path. Two possibilities: 1) side-proxy added a tool call header that caused the platform to run an extra tool invocation (adds tokens), or 2) header triggered a telemetry agent to attach a system prompt for tracing.
Mia L. (Eng): I pulled the server trace for req_0ab3. Snippet: `runtime: attach_system_block reason=side-proxy-annotation size=2680 tokens` Looks like an integration point that, when certain headers exist, creates an extra system preamble. That preamble is billable and appears in invoice as `meta.injected_tokens`.
Alex R. (Support): ACME — two options: 1) drop the header or route without the proxy, 2) we can request a billing adjustment for March while engineering fixes the platform behavior. Which do you prefer?
ACME Inc (Customer): we'd prefer a billing adjustment and a patch. We cannot change proxy config today.
Jordan P. (PM): assigning to eng to scope the fix; also will open a billing credit request. Mia, can you own the engineering investigation? Alex, Sam, please coordinate the credit flow.
Mia L. (Eng): I'll look into why the runtime attaches the system block for that header pattern. Initial hypothesis: a legacy telemetry rule treated `x-customer-log` as needing enriched context. I'll post findings in this thread in ~2 business hours.
Billing Bot: Credit request submitted: CR-2026-4421 for INV-98765 (amount pending review).
Alex R. (Support): Thanks everyone. ACME, I'll loop in once billing approves and when Mia has a remediation plan.
ACME Inc (Customer): thanks — appreciate the fast triage.
Mia L. (Eng): quick follow-up note: reproduced locally with a patched side-proxy; runtime condition is `if header contains "x-customer-log" then attach system_preamble(v1)`. I'm going to propose changing the rule to only attach when header value matches a telemetry-enrollment token. Patch PR incoming.
Sam D. (DevEx): once PR is up we'll add a note to the SDK/Docs about headers that may influence runtime behavior.
Alex R. (Support): action items: [Mia] PR & rollback plan, [Billing] process credit, [Sam] docs update, [ACME] share any other proxy headers.
Jordan P. (PM): tracking in JIRA: RED-3219. Closing loop after credit and release. :white_check_mark:
